name: SSSOM (Simple Standard for Sharing Ontological Mappings)
what_it_illuminates: How confident and how justified each crosswalk link is
integration_detail: Publish every EMST crosswalk (v1->v2, O*NET-SOC/tasks, ESCO, OPM, SOC, CIP) as SSSOM TSV with predicate_id, mapping_justification (semapv), confidence, author/reviewer and target version

name: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0
what_it_illuminates: What a version bump promises to consumers
integration_detail: Version taxonomy releases MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with taxonomy-specific rules (report section 8); separate schema and code versions

name: Frictionless Data Table Schema / Data Package
what_it_illuminates: Keys and integrity of published CSV
integration_detail: Ship a datapackage.json with Table Schema (primaryKey, foreignKeys) for every CSV export so third parties can validate

name: Citation File Format + Zenodo DOI
integration_detail: CITATION.cff in repo; Zenodo GitHub integration mints a DOI per release tag

name: Open Skills Management Tool (OSMT) / Rich Skill Descriptors
what_it_illuminates: Record lifecycle and publication states for skills
integration_detail: Compare the EMST status vocabulary (draft/candidate/published/deprecated/superseded/withdrawn) with OSMT PublishStatus; consider RSD export via IA

name: CTDL-ASN (Credential Engine)
integration_detail: Use ceasn alignment predicates (exactAlignment, broad/narrow, major/minor) in SSSOM rows; IA owns export

name: OpenLMP / LMPs pipeline

integration_detail: Reuse repo patterns (provenance per record, schema validation, gold-set evaluation, generated status, CC0/Apache split); ingest components.parquet as demand signals linked to EMST task IDs (IA/LM)

name: W3C SKOS
integration_detail: Export EMST vocabularies and competencies as SKOS concept schemes; skos mapping predicates in SSSOM

name: W3C PROV-O
what_it_illuminates: Who produced which record, from what, how
